about: Each kind of line migration never handles is skipped, even when it carries a status tag, and so is a comment starting on the line directly below one: a - [r] request (with the comment under it), a - [b] line (with its comment), a closed - [x] request carrying #research/run-1 (with its indented [AGENT] link line, and the comment directly below that link line), a second closed research request with a comment directly below it, and an [AGENT] bullet (with its comment).
